evidence.publicAccess: Recreation.gov identifies Spring Bar Campground as a popular Salmon River take-out with a boat-launching ramp and 18 tent campsites.
evidence.landManager: Forest Service destination material places Spring Bar Campground in the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests and repeats the take-out and ramp description.
evidence.accessMaintenance: Idaho Fish and Game documents restoration of the Spring Bar boat ramp along the Salmon River in partnership with the Forest Service.
evidence.coordinateFit: The stored coordinate matches the mapped Spring Bar Campground feature. The 427-foot named-flowline offset is consistent with a campground/road access-area anchor and does not justify moving the point onto the river centerline.

action.condition: Confirm current Forest Service road/campground status, ramp condition, parking, and carry at arrival; the named site is public but seasonal conditions can change.
